newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian call easy, newly auctioned paper at premium.
newsitem.headline: Indian call easy, newly auctioned paper at premium.

text.p: Indian call levels fell to 2.00-3.00 percent after opening at 3.00-4.00 percent on Wednesday compared to the previous close of 1.50-2.00 percent, dealers said.
Call rates will rule easy on Wednesday, despite outflow of 20 billion rupees on account of the seven-year bond auctioned on Tuesday, dealers said.
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said it set a cut-off of 12.59 percent at the auction.
RBI said it received 310 bids for 54.50 billion rupees of which it accepted 54 (34 in full and the rest partial) for the notified amount.
The newly auctioned stock was traded in the region of 100.50 rupees to 100.80 rupees on Wednesday and was quoted at 100.70/80 in latest trade, dealers said.
